# wrk-nsdelay

Generate HTTP requests using WRK from multiple network namespaces

Launches `GEN_PROCESS` WRK processes, each in its own network namespace bridged to the first NIC,
optionally with a bandwidth limit of `GEN_PROCESS_RATE` Mbps per namespace.
The client addresses are `CLI_PREFIX.X`, and the traffic is routed through the gateway `PGW_IP` of the "pgw" role:
your test must define `CLI_PREFIX` and `PGW_IP`.

Generate HTTP requests towards `http://server/bin-XK` files using WRK.

The HTTP server configuration is not part of this test. Your main test
should include something like `FILE_PATH={file1,file2}`.

The requests go to the address of the node having the "dut" role. The port can be changed setting the `HTTP_PORT` variable.

See `generic/http.wrk` for examples such as fetching files with sizes from 1K to 1G.
See `experiments/test_wrk.test` for an experiment trying to find the best configuration for 1K requests varying `GEN_THREADS` and `GEN_CONCURRENT` on a 16 cores CPU.

Source: [`modules/wrk-nsdelay.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/wrk-nsdelay.npf)

## Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `WRKSCRIPTCMD` | `EXPAND(-s $WRKSCRIPT )` with `wrkpath`<br>*empty* with not `wrkpath` |  |
| `GEN_CONCURRENT` | `128` | Number of concurrent connections, split among the processes |
| `GEN_PROCESS_RATE` | `0` | Bandwidth limit of each namespace in Mbps, 0 for no limit |
| `GEN_THREADS` | `16` | Number of WRK threads, at most GEN_CONCURRENT |
| `GEN_PROCESS` | `1` | Number of WRK processes, each in its own namespace |
| `FILE_PATH` | `index.htm` | Path of the requested file on the server |
| `HTTP_PORT` | `80` | Port of the HTTP server |
| `GEN_TIME` | `10` | Duration of the test in seconds |
| `WRKNIC` | `0` |  |
| `WRK_HOST` | `EXPAND(${dut:0:ip})` | Address of the HTTP server, by default the first address of the dut role |
| `WRK_PROTOCOL` | `http` | Protocol, http or https |

```{collapse} Late variables

Late variables are evaluated after the variables above.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GEN_PROCESS` | `1` |  |
| `GEN_PROCESS_RATE` | `0` |  |
```
